name: Gastly (CobbleEffort form)
look: a red ball with one horn and yellow spots, a big white cyclops eye and a fanged purple mouth, in a cloud of glowing yellow-orange flame gas
entry: A cyclops ball of hellfire wrapped in burning gas. It drifts over badlands and deserts on hot nights, and anything that breathes its gas feels faint and feverish for days.
how: Wild: uncommon in badlands, deserts and savannas at night, and all over the Nether.
Evolves into the CobbleEffort Haunter at level 25.
